newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel shares continue to climb.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel shares continue to climb.

text.p: Shares in French telecommunications and engineering giant Alcatel Alsthom continued to gain ground on Friday, bolstered by Thursday's half-year earnings figures, traders said.
By 1242 GMT, the company was up 4.69 percent or 19.1 francs at 430.1 francs in heavy volume of 669,611 shares.
"There has been some short covering on the share, and there are a lot of people buying basically on what they hope for the future of the company under (chairman Serge) Tchuruk," said one trader.

The company reported on Thursday that it had slashed its first-half loss to 400 million francs from a loss of 1.2 billion francs a year earlier and announced it was on target to post a full year profit of "several billion francs".
